ecosystem.title: Quick answers
ecosystem.description: First questions brand teams ask before a factory quote.

items.title: What information do you need for a first quote?
items.description: Style photos or tech pack, target materials, approximate MOQ, and destination market.

items.title: Do you support OEM and ODM?
items.description: Yes—build from your design, or develop with our sampling team.

items.title: Can you work with vegan materials?
items.description: Yes—PU and other alternatives alongside leather programs.

items.title: How do sampling and bulk lead times work?
items.description: Sample timing depends on complexity; bulk starts after sample approval and material lock.
